name: memory_forget
description: Deletes stored memory using exactly one target mode (observation_id for a single fact, entity for an entity and all attached facts/relations, or source+target for relation edges) and scrubs deleted storage pages so obsolete or erroneous records are purged, preventing stale or sensitive data retention.

observation_id.description: Specifies the unique observation ID to delete in single-fact mode so the targeted observation is removed from SQLite and FTS5 indexes, preventing stale fact retention.

entity.description: Specifies the entity name to cascade-delete along with all of its observations and relations so decommissioned nodes are purged completely, preventing orphaned graph records.

source.description: Specifies the source entity name when deleting directed relation edges (used together with 'target') so edge removal is scoped to the exact origin node, preventing unintended edge deletion.

target.description: Specifies the target entity name when deleting directed relation edges (used together with 'source') so edge removal is scoped to the exact destination node, preventing unintended edge deletion.

relation_type.description: Restricts relation edge deletion between 'source' and 'target' to a single snake_case verb (deleting all edge types between the pair when omitted) so other relationships between the same entities remain intact, preventing over-broad edge pruning.
